dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: I take it that's what they call "business expansion"?

dialogues.speaker: Pakaa Nui
dialogues.text: Ah, you've got a head for this.

dialogues.speaker: Pakaa Nui
dialogues.text: I know some real music fanatics, including a records artisan from the Children of Echoes, and graffiti artists from the Masters of the Night-Wind.

dialogues.speaker: Pakaa Nui
dialogues.text: That way, we not only help release records but aid in packaging and promotion as well.

dialogues.speaker: Pakaa Nui
dialogues.text: Good, comprehensive service, wouldn't you say?
